sources.text: the ledger report is useless to me in the morning. its a wall of numbers and i dont know what to do with it. i want to open tinkery and in like 5 seconds know if yesterday went well or not. maybe one number? useful changes per hour is the one that matters. cost too maybe. i dont want a dashboard. also the 6am job sometimes fails silently and i only find out days later
a failed job should override everything. cost only matters if its way off
